speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your heart rate, such as feeling your heart beating slowly or irregularly?

speaker: Patient
text: I haven't really noticed my heart beating slowly or irregularly, but I do agree that feeling unusually tired and gaining weight without changing my habits are the main issues I've been facing lately.
